FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS

Before we begin.

What services does R&D MECA offer?+

We offer mechanical design, analysis and validation, industrialisation and reliability, and preventive, predictive and corrective maintenance. Each assignment is defined around your needs.

What should I prepare for an initial discussion?+

A description of your needs, the equipment involved and your timescale is enough to start. Drawings, photos and technical information can then be shared by email.

Can I request a focused study or assignment?+

Yes. We can discuss a specific assignment or broader support. Scope, deliverables and terms are agreed before the work begins.

Are MecMaroc and R&D MECA connected?+

Yes. MecMaroc is the previous name of our activity, now presented under the R&D MECA identity and the rdmeca.com domain.
